674	async function handleDisputeCreated(
675	  dispute: StripeDisputeShape,
676	  supabase: SupabaseServiceClient,
677	): Promise<void> {
678	  const chargeField = dispute.charge
679	  const chargeId =
680	    typeof chargeField === 'string'
681	      ? chargeField
682	      : ((chargeField as { id?: string } | null)?.id ?? null)
683	
684	  if (!chargeId) {
685	    logger.warn({ disputeId: dispute.id }, 'stripe: dispute missing charge id — skipping')
686	    return
687	  }
688	
689	  const studioId = await resolveStudioIdFromCharge(chargeId, supabase)
690	  if (!studioId) {
691	    logger.warn({ disputeId: dispute.id, chargeId }, 'stripe: could not resolve studio_id for dispute')
692	    return
693	  }
694	
695	  const evidenceDueBy = dispute.evidence_details?.due_by
696	    ? new Date(dispute.evidence_details.due_by * 1_000).toISOString()
697	    : new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000).toISOString()
698	
699	  const args: StripeDisputeRecordArgs = {
700	    studioId,
701	    disputeId: dispute.id,
702	    chargeId,
703	    reason: dispute.reason ?? '',
704	    status: (dispute.status ?? 'warning_needs_response') as StripeDisputeStatus,
705	    amountCents: cents(dispute.amount),
706	    currency: (dispute.currency ?? 'usd') as Currency,
707	    evidenceDueBy,
708	  }
709	
710	  const rpc = supabase.rpc.bind(supabase) as unknown as UntypedRpc
711	  const { data, error } = await rpc(RPC.STRIPE_DISPUTE_RECORD, {
712	    p_studio_id: args.studioId,
713	    p_dispute_id: args.disputeId,
714	    p_charge_id: args.chargeId,
715	    p_reason: args.reason,
716	    p_status: args.status,
717	    p_amount_cents: args.amountCents,
718	    p_currency: args.currency,
719	    p_evidence_due_by: args.evidenceDueBy,
720	  })
721	
722	  if (error) {
723	    logger.error({ err: error, disputeId: dispute.id }, 'stripe: dispute.created RPC failed')
724	    throw error
725	  }
726	
727	  logger.info({ disputeId: dispute.id, studioId, result: data }, 'stripe: dispute recorded')
